and is attacking our lands again.

extremely distorted and fragile.
m400575.この子が急に茶目っ気を発揮したみたいで、\n塔を全部融合させるっていう悪戯をした:
It seems this one suddenly felt mischievous and
played a prank by fusing all the towers together.
m400575.これで塔は元に戻るのですか？: Will the tower revert to its original state now?
m400575.そういうことなので王子君。\n塔を解体し、元に戻すのに協力してもらえませんか？: So, Prince. Could you help us dismantle the structure and restore it to its original state?
m400575.その代わり、現時点での最上階に\n全戦力が集結しているみたいですが……。: However, it appears all their forces have gathered on the topmost floor…
m400575.そもそも設計思想の異なる施設同士だったんですから、\n全部混ざっちゃった以上、今: Besides, they were designed with completely different philosophies to begin with. Now that everything is blended together, I doubt they can be used for military training the way they were before.
m400575.それで作戦についてですが、\nかなりの数の敵と戦うことが予想されるため、\n『大: As for the strategy, we expect to face a considerable number of enemies, so I propose issuing a "Grand Subjugation Mission."
m400575.それに、塔が合体した原因も分かりましたから。: Besides, we've figured out what caused the towers to merge.
m400575.それは……あなたが連れている幽霊、ですか？: That is……the ghost you're carrying around, isn't it?
m400575.それは、なにか根拠があってのことですか？: Is there some basis for that?
m400575.それを踏まえて、指揮を頼むぞ、王子！: With that in mind, I'm leaving the command to you, Prince!
m400575.そんなこと言ってもしょうがないじゃないですか！\n現に合体しちゃったんですから！: Saying that doesn't change anything! They're already combined!
m400575.そんな目で私を見ないでくださいよ……。: Please stop looking at me like that…
m400575.そんな脆弱な塔を崩れないように維持しているのが、\nあの守護者だと思われるからで:
I believe that Guardian is what's keeping such a
vulnerable tower from collapsing.
m400575.つまり、各塔にあった条件などは、\n一切適用されないということです。:
That means none of the conditions that applied to the individual towers
will be in effect.
m400575.つまりあの守護者さえ倒せば、塔は自然と元通りになって、\nこの事件は全部まるっと:
So if we defeat that Guardian, the tower will naturally return to normal,
and this whole incident will be resolved in one go, is that right?
m400575.つまり部隊を展開するためには、『援軍要請』を持つ者や、\nワルキューレたちを編成: In other words, to deploy our units, we'll need to include those who can issue "Reinforcement Requests," as well as the Valkyries.
m400575.ていうか塔で働いてた私はどうすればいいんですかー！？: Wait, what am I supposed to do? I worked in the towers!
m400575.でしたら、私たちはもう戻りましょうか。: In that case, we should head back.
m400575.となると、あれを優先して狙うほうが良さそうだな。: If that's the case, we should probably prioritize targeting it.
m400575.とりあえず後の処理は、ソラス様とニミュエ様、\nそれからアンブローズ様にお任せす: For now, I'll leave the aftermath to Solais, Nimue, and Ambrose.
m400575.どうしてそんなことになったのかはともかく、\n各塔が混ざるとなにか不都合があるん: Setting aside how this happened, is there any downside to the towers being mixed together?
m400575.どうやら、全部解決したみたいですね。: It seems everything has been resolved.
m400575.どんな手違いがあったら、\nあんな巨大な建造物が一つに融合するんですか……？: What kind of mistake causes massive structures like those to merge into one…?
m400575.なにか、特別強そうな守護者がいませんか……？: Is there a Guardian that looks particularly strong……?
m400575.なるほど！ アンブローズ様は、\nニミュエ様を手伝いたいと思っているものの、\n: I see! So Ambrose wants to help Nimue, but feels awkward about it because he's been absent for a thousand years!
m400575.なんで一つになっちゃったのかとか、\nそもそも塔は今どういう状態なのかとか、\n: We need to properly figure out why they merged in the first place, and what state the towers are currently in.
m400575.はい、どうやら今回の事件の犯人は、\nこの子だったみたいです。:
Yes, it appears the culprit behind this incident was
this one.
m400575.はい、ソラス様と私で事足りると思いますー。\nなのでアンブローズ様は帰ってもらっ: Yes, I think Solais and I can manage. So you may head home, Ambrose.
m400575.ひんっ！？\nそんなはっきり言わないでくださいよぉ！？: Hmph!? Don't say things so bluntly!
m400575.まぁ、可能性があるっていうか、\nほぼ確実にそうなると思いますよ。: Well, "a chance" is putting it mildly. I'm almost certain that's what will happen.
m400575.まったくもってそのとおりですよー！\nだから私たちで、塔を元に戻してあげましょう:
You're absolutely right!
So let us restore the towers to how they were!!
m400575.もう出てくる気配もありませんし、\n諸々の作業に集中できそうです。: There's no sign of any more coming, so we can focus on the work at hand.
m400575.やったぁ！\nこれでまた王子さまたちに挑んでもらえますね！:
Yaaay!
Now you can challenge us again, Prince and the others!
m400575.ライフが０になっても倒した敵の数は\nばっちりカウントされるので、\n諦めず敵に:
Even if your Life drops to zero, the enemies you defeat will still be counted.
So don't give up—keep standing your ground against them.
m400575.一応反省してるみたいですし、\n私の方からも叱っておくので、\n許してもらえない:
It looks like it's regretting it now, so
I'll give it a scolding on my end too.
Could you please forgive it……?
m400575.一応点検はしないといけませんが、\nすぐに各塔を利用できる状態にはしておくので、:
We'll need to run some inspections, but
we'll get each tower back into a usable state right away,
so please rest assured.
m400575.仕事に誇りを持ちすぎていますねぇ……。: They take far too much pride in their work…
m400575.仕事熱心なのは誇らしいことですが、\n塔の皆さんを助ける邪魔をされるのは困ります:
Their dedication to duty is admirable, but
it's a nuisance when it gets in the way of helping the tower's residents.
m400575.同じくですね。\nおそらくは塔が混ざり合った際に生まれた、\n新しい守護者なので:
Same here.
It's likely a new Guardian born when the towers merged.
m400575.塔たちのそれぞれの部品が、\n元ある場所に戻っていく感じがしますし、\nもう大丈:
It feels like the components of each tower are
returning to their original places, so I think we're safe now.
m400575.塔たちを元に戻すために、\n同僚のみんなには眠ってもらいますよー！！: To restore the towers to normal, I'll put my colleagues to sleep!!
m400575.塔の守護者たちは、こちらと戦うつもりのようだな。: The tower's Guardians appear intent on fighting us.
m400575.大ありですよー！\nあれらは訓練施設でもあるんですから！: A huge one! Those are training facilities, after all!
m400575.少し中を覗いてみましたけど、\nそれぞれの塔の機構が干渉し合ってるらしく、\n現: I took a quick peek inside, and it looks like the mechanisms of each tower are interfering with one another, so nothing is operating normally right now!
m400575.当然スコアだとかもなくなっているので、\nこれから挑む塔は、訓練施設ではなく、\:
Naturally, scores and such are gone too.
So please think of the tower we're about to enter not as a training facility,
but simply as a building…
m400575.手伝いは、もういらない感じですかぁ？: Is there no more need for my help?
m400575.最後に、塔は混ざり合った影響で、\nそれぞれにあった特性が失われています。:
Finally, due to the effects of the merger,
the tower has lost its individual characteristics.
m400575.混ざった塔から得られるものはほとんどないので、\n敵を倒しても、EXPやゴールド:
There is very little to gain from the merged tower.
Please be aware that defeating enemies will not yield any EXP or Gold.
m400575.温まってきたみたいですし、そろそろ向かうとしましょうか。: It seems everyone's spirits are rising. Let's head over then.
m400575.王子、此度の討伐お疲れ様でした！: Prince, well done on this subjugation!
m400575.目標は、塔の調査及び解体を妨害する敵を、\n可能な限り減らすことです。\nとにか:
The objective is to reduce, as much as possible, the number of enemies interfering with the investigation and dismantling of the tower.
Please focus entirely on defeating them!
m400575.相当深刻な不具合が起きているようですね。: It seems a rather serious malfunction is occurring.
m400575.私が占星術師で、英傑の塔にずっといたから。\n……というのは根拠として不十分です: I'm an astrologer who has been stationed in the Tower of Heroes all this time. ……Is that not sufficient proof?
m400575.私たちの侵入を感知して、\n塔が大量の守護者を出してくる可能性がありますので。: There's a chance the tower will detect our intrusion and deploy a large number of Guardians.
m400575.私とニミュエちゃんで、\nそれぞれの塔を点検していたんですが、\nちょーっとだけ: Solais and I were inspecting our respective towers, but it seems we made a little… mistake.
m400575.私は二本ほど塔を設計していますが、\n製作者の言うことも聞けない感じですかー？: I've designed a couple of towers myself, but is this what it's like when even the creators can't get a word in?
m400575.統帥の塔にあった特定の人だけ有利に戦える機能や、\n悪霊の塔にあった入場制限はな:
It seems the feature in the Command Tower that favored specific individuals,
as well as the entry restrictions in the Wraith Tower, have vanished.
m400575.自分たちが試練を与える者という認識だけは、\n混ざり合っても変わらなかったみたい:
It seems the notion that they are the ones who bestow trials upon others
has remained unchanged, even after the merger.
m400575.英傑の塔、統帥の塔、悪霊の塔の三つの塔が、\nなんでか一つに融合しちゃったんです: The Tower of Heroes, the Tower of Command, and the Tower of Wraiths have somehow fused into a single structure…
m400575.融合した際の機構の欠陥で生まれたようなものですから、\n長期間稼働することはでき:
It seems it was born from a flaw in the mechanism during the fusion,
so it apparently couldn't operate for a long period.
m400575.行き場を失った者もいるようですね……。: It seems some of us have lost our place…
m400575.製作者の知らない敵が出てくるのは、\n怖いような、面白いような……。:
Facing an enemy the creators don't know about is
a bit scary, but also kind of exciting……
m400575.襲いかかってくるみたいだから対応するが、\nその新しい守護者とやらは倒しても構わ:
It looks like it's about to lunge at us, so we'll deal with it, but
is it all right if we take down that new Guardian?
m400575.要するに、戦闘は避けられないということですか。: So, in short, combat is unavoidable.
m400575.解体……の前に調査をするんだったか。: We need to investigate before we start dismantling…
m400575.言いたいことがあるなら、\n本人にはっきり伝えるべきだと思いますが。: If you have something to say, you should just say it to her directly.

m500434.――勝った後の相談じゃなくて、\n負けた後の相談でもしておくべきだと思うよ。: I think we should have a talk about what to do if we lose, not just if we win.
m500434.――報告は以上だ。\n鬼たちに復活する様子はないし、\nソハヤノツルギも、完全に:
――That concludes the report.
The demons show no signs of reviving,
and Sohayano Tsurugi appears to be completely shattered.
m500434.――見事、なり……鬼狩りの、英雄、よ……。: ...Impressive... You are truly the hero of the demon hunters...
m500434.――貴様と手を組む日が来るとはなァ。: ――To think the day would come when I'd join hands with you.
m500434.…………何が、馬鹿娘、だ。酒呑よ。: ……What a foolish girl, huh. Wine Cellar Boy.
m500434.……ありがとう。\nこれからも、あては一緒に戦うから。\nずっと、ずーっとね！:
……Thank you.
From now on, I'll be fighting by your side.
For a long, long time!
m500434.……ぐふぅッ……クソッ……。\nこの酒呑童子が……ここで、終わりか……。:
...Ugh... Damn it...
Is this... where Wine Cellar Boy's story ends...?
m500434.……これは、骨が折れそうだな。: ...This is going to be a tough fight.
m500434.「大嶽丸」と「酒呑童子」が手を組みやがった！！: "Otakemaru" and "Wine Cellar Boy" have joined forces!!
m500434.ああ……立派に、育った、な……。: Ah…… you really have grown up.
m500434.あっちが同じ力を使ってくるわけだ。\nたぶん、こっちが使う以上に強力だけどなァ。:
That means they'll be using the same power against us.
It's probably even stronger than how we use it.
So protect it with your lives!
m500434.あてこそが、悪逆非道の鬼を討つべく、\n人と共に並び立つ――茨木童子、鬼刃姫だ！:
I am the one who will slay the wicked demons,
standing side by side with humanity—Ibaraki Doji, Kibahime!!
m500434.あては逃げも隠れもしないよ。\n悪鬼酒呑童子！\n善なる鬼、茨木童子が、その首も:
I don't run, and I don't hide.
Evil demon, Wine Cellar Boy!
The good demon, Ibaraki Doji, has come to take your head!!
m500434.いやいや、矜持で生きてるような鬼が、\nその矜持を捨てて、文字通り命懸けで挑んで:
No, no. These are demons who live by their pride.
They are throwing that pride away and coming at us with everything they have.
m500434.えぇ。東の国に一時の平穏が訪れても、\n別のどこかでは、争いの火種が生まれるもの:
Yes. Even if the Eastern Kingdom enjoys a moment of peace,
conflict is bound to brew somewhere else.
m500434.おいおい、笑えない冗談だなぁホムラ。\nあいつらが手を結ぶはずないだろ。\nプラ:
Hey, hey, that's no joke, Homura.
There's no way they'd team up.
They're both made of pure pride, you know?
m500434.おう、殺れるモンなら殺ってみやがれ茨木童子ィ。: Yeah, try and kill me if you can, Ibaraki Doji.
m500434.おうよ。\nその後は仲良く殺し合いでもしようや。\n鬼ってのは、そういうもんだか:
Agreed.
After that, we can have a friendly duel to the death.
That's just how demons are!
m500434.おぉ、馬鹿娘じゃねぇか。\nてっきり隠れて出てこねェかと思ってたぜ。:
Oh, you're a stupid girl, aren't you?
I was wondering if you'd stay hidden and never show up.
m500434.こっちが使っている間は心強そうですぽん。\n……で、ででで、でも、奪われちゃった:
It sounds reassuring while we're using it, pon.
...B-but, but, but, if it gets taken away from us—!
m500434.さぁて、あれがソハヤノツルギか。\n鬼狩りの魔剣とやら、鬼が振るえばどうなるか―:
So that's the Sohayano Tsurugi.
What will happen when a demon swings the demon hunter's cursed blade?
m500434.さぁ王子、凱旋だよ！\n胸を張って、王国に帰ろ！:
Come on, Prince. It's time for our victory parade!
Hold your head high and let's return to the kingdom!
m500434.されど、その鬼を討つ男が、この時代にいる。\nならば討たねばならん。\n鬼狩りの:
Yet, there is a man in this age who slays demons.
Then, we must slay him.
We must hunt human heads with the sword of the demon hunter.
m500434.そうだよ皆！\nあの鬼たちに苦しめられていた、\n東の国の人たちを助けられたんだ:
That's right, everyone!
We saved the people of the Eastern Kingdom
who had been suffering under those demons!
m500434.そして、ともに戦う仲間には、\nより強い力を与える、とも伝わっているわ。: And it is also said to grant greater power to those who fight alongside you.
m500434.その身に傷を負わせぬ、護法の剣か。\nそんなの持ってんなら、\nソハヤノツルギは:
A protective sword that prevents its wielder from being wounded?
If you have something like that,
do you even need the Sohayano Tsurugi?
m500434.その魔剣が、魔王決戦時の\n大規模な地割れから見つかってね。: That sword was discovered in a massive fissure that opened during the final battle with the Demon King.
m500434.それが残念なことに、事実なのよ……。: Unfortunately... that is exactly what has happened.
m500434.ど、どうなるんですかぽん！？\nさっきまであたし様たちのこと助けてくれてたのに！:
W-What are we going to do, pon!?
They were helping us just a moment ago!
m500434.なぜか分かるか、馬鹿娘の茨木童子。: Do you know why, you foolish Ibaraki Doji?
m500434.ふぅ……ようやく一段落だな。: Phew…… I think we can finally breathe a sigh of relief.
m500434.ほらほら、東の国のお酒にお料理にぃ～。: Come on, come on. The Eastern Kingdom's fine sake and cuisine, here we come~.
m500434.ぽこぽん？\nでも前に、王子さまたちは大嶽丸にも\n酒呑童子にも勝ったことがある:
Pokopon?
But didn't the Prince and his allies defeat both Otakemaru
and Wine Cellar Boy before, Pon?
m500434.カッ、そうかもしれねェ。\nだがその本質は違う。:
Ha, maybe you're right.
But that's not the real reason.
m500434.ククッ……然り……。\n互いに王子とは因縁のある身なれど、\n鬼同士が手を組むこ:
Kuk... Indeed...
Though we both have our own history with the Prince,
it was unthinkable for two demons to form an alliance.
m500434.ケッ……殺すつもりで来たくせに、\n何、泣きそうな顔……してやがる……。:
Tch... You came here to kill me,
and yet... why do you look like you're about to cry...?
m500434.ソハヤノツルギ……ははぁん、\n大嶽丸の野郎が、大昔に痛い目を見た魔剣だな？:
Sohayanotsurugi... I see.
That's the cursed blade that gave Otakemaru a nasty beating in the old days, isn't it?
m500434.ソハヤノツルギが人の手に渡れば、\n今度こそ、大嶽丸も酒呑童子も年貢の納め時って:
If Sohayanotsurugi falls into human hands,
this will finally be the end for both Otakemaru and Wine Cellar Boy.
m500434.ソハヤノツルギって言やぁ、\nその剣気の波動によって、体力自慢の相手ほど\n大き: The Sohayano Tsurugi is a cursed sword that inflicts greater damage on opponents with high stamina, thanks to its sword-qi waves.
m500434.人の手にあるならば鬼を討ち、\n鬼の手にあるならば国を崩す。\n正真正銘、本物の:
In human hands, it slays demons.
In a demon's hands, it brings a nation to ruin.
It is a genuine, bona fide cursed sword.
m500434.休んでいる暇はないと思うぞ？\n亜神に魔神に神獣に、この地を荒らす者は尽きる様子:
I don't think we have time to rest, though.
Sub-gods, great gods, divine beasts…… the threats ravaging this land show no sign of ending.
m500434.何しろ、名高い悪鬼、大嶽丸と酒呑童子を、\n同時に仕留めたってんだ。\nほら、叫:
After all, we just took down two of the most notorious demons,
Otakemaru and Wine Cellar Boy, at the same time.
Come on, let's yell! Let's drink! And while we're at it, let's dance!
m500434.同じことをやり返されるんだよ！\nあてたちの体力は削られるし、あいつらの力も強く:
They're going to do the same thing to us!
Our health will drain away, and their power will grow stronger!
m500434.地割れの先には、古代の祭殿が、\n当時の姿そのままに残されていたのよ。\nもちろ:
At the bottom of the fissure lay an ancient shrine hall,
preserved exactly as it was back then.
And, of course, Sohayanotsurugi was right there with it.
m500434.大丈夫、王子。\nあてが……終わらせてあげなくちゃ。:
Don't worry, Prince.
I... I have to put him out of his misery.
m500434.悪事を働いた代償だよ。: It's the price you pay for your wicked deeds.
m500434.悪巧みは終わったか？ 人間ども。\nならば行くぞ、我が剣――三明剣。:
Are you done with your scheming, humans?
Then let's go, my blade—Sanmeiken.
m500434.昔話じゃァよぉ、鬼はいつもやられてばかり、\n懲らしめられて泣いて謝る役柄だ。:
In the old tales, demons are always the ones who get beaten up,
humiliated, and forced to cry and apologize.
m500434.本気ってやつを、滅多に見せねェからだよ。\nさぁ、これこそが、大悪鬼酒呑童子サマ:
It's because they rarely show their true power.
Now then, witness the true might of the Great Evil Demon, Wine Cellar Boy!!
m500434.東の国の霊峰で、伝説の鬼狩りの魔剣、\n「ソハヤノツルギ」が見つかったのは知って: Did you hear that the legendary demon-slaying sword, "Sohayanotsurugi," has been found on a sacred peak in the eastern country?
m500434.此なるは、人が鬼を狩る剣に非ず。\n鬼がその暴威を解き放ち、\n国すら刈り取る魔:
This is no sword for humans to hunt demons.
It is a demonic blade that unleashes the demon's wrath,
a sword that can reap entire nations.
m500434.王子、あれがソハヤノツルギだよ。\n私たちが使えば心強い味方に、\n敵に奪われれ:
Prince, that is the Sohayano Tsurugi.
In our hands, it's a powerful ally,
but if the enemy takes it, it becomes a terrifying weapon.
m500434.王子、絶対に油断しちゃだめだよ。\n父上――うぅん、酒呑童子は、\nきっとこの戦:
Prince, you must not let your guard down for a moment.
Father――well, Wine Cellar Boy is surely
going to treat this battle as a fight for his life.
m500434.王子よ、我らが因縁に決着をつけよう。: Prince. Let us settle our grudge.
m500434.真面目だなァ、まったく。\nこういう時は酒でも飲んで馬鹿騒ぎするもんだぜ？:
You're all so serious. Honestly.
In times like this, you should be drinking and making a racket!
m500434.笑止――もはや油断も驕りもせぬ。\n慢心を捨てた鬼の力、とくと味わえ。:
Nonsense—I no longer let my guard down or grow arrogant.
Taste the power of a demon who has cast aside complacency.
m500434.自分たちを殺しうる魔剣を、\n人の手に渡さず、己の物とするためにな。:
To keep the sword that could kill them
from falling into human hands, and to claim it for themselves.
m500434.良いだろう。\n貴様の首、刈り取ってみたいと思っていたところだ。:
Very well.
I have been longing to cut off your head.
m500434.行くぜ馬鹿娘。\nこれが酒呑童子の戦いだッ！！:
Let's go, you stupid girl.
This is the battle of Wine Cellar Boy!!
m500434.酒呑童子、大嶽丸、長きにわたる数多の悪行、\n決して赦すに値せず！:
Wine Cellar Boy, Otakemaru, your countless evil deeds over the long years
are never to be forgiven!
m500434.鬼とは強く、孤独であるものだ。\n他の妖怪連中とはワケが違ぇ……。:
A demon is strong, and a demon is alone.
We are a different breed from the other yokai...
m500434.鬼は倒れ、ソハヤノツルギも砕け散り……。\nやれやれ、これで決着、か。:
The demons have fallen, and Sohayano Tsurugi is shattered to pieces…….
Well, well. It looks like this is settled.
m500434.鬼狩りの魔剣、ソハヤノツルギか……。\n随分と人に都合の良い名付けをしたものだ。:
Sohayano Tsurugi, the demon-slaying sword…….
What a convenient name humans have given it.
m500434.鬼退治の英雄は、かっこよく帰らなくちゃね！: A hero who slays demons has to make a grand entrance, after all!

m920044.……知ったことか！\n渡す気がないのなら力ずくで奪うまでだ。\n我らが率いる軍勢: …What do you care! If you won't give it, we'll take it by force. Do you think you can stand against the army we command alone?
m920044.……答える義理はない。\n魔物共！ 奴らを排除しろ！！: …I have no obligation to answer. Monsters! Eliminate them!!
m920044.あぁそうだ。あいつら、ここにあるミスリル鉱を\n全て奪うつもりだ！: Yeah, that's right. They're planning to take every bit of mithril ore in this place!
m920044.あなたはミスリル鉱を集めて\nどうするつもりなんですか？: What do you intend to do with the mithril ore?
m920044.あの様子……、どうも話が通じなさそうです。\n王子、お気を付けください。:
They don't seem to be listening at all.
Prince, be careful.
m920044.あの機甲兵を近距離で対処される際はご注意を。: Be careful if you try to take it on up close.
m920044.あの熱気は……！\nどうやらあの魔物から放出されているようです！！\nお気を付け: That heat…! It seems to be coming from that monster!! Be careful!
m920044.あの魔物……、初めてみるタイプです。: That monster… it's a type I've never seen before.
m920044.あの魔物からは生命エネルギーのようなものは\n感じませんでした。\nこの洞窟の鉱:
I didn't sense any life energy coming from it.
Perhaps it's just the cave's ore that's gone bad….
m920044.あの魔物の麻痺攻撃に注意してください。\n体力を減らして弱らせれば、\n麻痺攻撃: Watch out for that monster's paralysis attack. If we wear down its health, it should stop using the paralyzing strike.
m920044.あれが古代の巨大兵器……！\n想像よりもなんて大きい……。\n王子、最大限の注意: That's the ancient colossal weapon…! It's even bigger than I imagined… Prince, stay on high alert!
m920044.あれは……。王子、あそこに魔物と戦っている方が！\n私たちも応戦いたしましょう！: Look, Prince—there's someone battling monsters over there! Let's join the fight!
m920044.あれは……機甲兵！\nこんな洞窟で遭遇するなんて……。: That… it's a mech soldier! I can't believe we'd run into one in a cave…
m920044.あれはダークエルフの中でも、\nダメージを受けるほどに攻撃力が増すという、\nア: That's a warrior among the Dark Elves whose attack power grows the more damage they take, called an Avenger.
m920044.あれはダークエルフ！ やはりこの洞窟内で何かを\n企んでいるという情報は本当のよ: That's a Dark Elf! So the intel about someone scheming in this cave was true.
m920044.え？ ではもし魔物から奪い返したミスリル鉱が\nございましたら、わたくしに分けて: Huh? Then, if you happen to have any mithril ore reclaimed from the monsters, could you share some with me?
m920044.おのれ……！ この洞窟のミスリル鉱を\n渡すわけにはいかん！！: Damn it…! I won't let anyone walk away with the mithril from this cave!!
m920044.くっ、思ったよりも早かったな。\nしかしすでに二体の古代兵器はわが手中にある、\: Damn, they're faster than I thought. But we already have two ancient weapons in our grasp—nothing to fear.
m920044.ここで採れる希少なミスリル鉱を使った武具を、\n作ってやらねばならぬ奴がいる。: There's someone who needs weapons made from this rare mithril ore.
m920044.ここはどうやら溶岩が流れているようです。\n先に進むためには避けられそうにありま: Looks like lava's flowing here. There's no way around it if we want to move forward…
m920044.ここまで追ってきて正解ですね。: It's good we chased them this far.
m920044.この洞窟にミスリル鉱が……。\nそれを採って集めれば……。: This cave holds mithril ore… If we gather it…
m920044.さ、王子。\n私たちはダークエルフの後を追いましょう！: Come on, Prince. Let's chase after the Dark Elf!
m920044.さすがは王子と言ったところか。\nあのゴーレムは未完成体ではあるが、\nやつらを: As expected of a Prince. That Golem's unfinished, but it's more than enough to crush them.
m920044.さっきダークエルフが、ミスリル鉱をもった魔物を\n従えてこの洞窟の奥に進みよった: The Dark Elf just led a monster carrying mithril deeper into the cave.
m920044.さっそくですか……。\n王子、戦闘の準備を！:
Already jumping into it, huh…?
Prince, prepare for battle!
m920044.そ、そうでしたか……。\n経緯はともかく、地上に被害が及ぶ前でよかったです。: I… I see. At least we stopped it before it could damage the surface.
m920044.そいつの為にもこの洞窟からミスリル鉱を奪おうと\nするやつは許しておけん！: For his sake, I won't forgive anyone who tries to take the mithril from this cave!
m920044.そいつは魔物と戦うためにも必要だと必死で\nワシに頼んできたのだ。: He begged me desperately, saying it's essential for fighting monsters.
m920044.そして、魔の力に反応するミスリル鉱で\n作られたものは石や鉄でできたゴーレムとは: And a Golem forged with mithril that reacts to dark energy dwarfs any stone- or iron-made one.
m920044.そのような悲劇を生むとわかっている\n兵器のために、ミスリル鉱は渡せないですわ。: I cannot give the mithril for a weapon I know will bring tragedy.
m920044.それに、これは聞いた話だがミスリル鉱を使えば\n強力な兵器を錬成することも可能ら: Also, I heard that if you use mithril ore, you can forge a powerful weapon.
m920044.それにしても、あの機甲兵、壊れかけて\nいるようですね。\n強い衝撃を与えると爆: And look, it's all rusted and broken. A strong blow could make it explode.
m920044.そんな……！ それではエルフの方たちが！\n王子、すぐに妖精郷へ向かいましょう！: No…! Then the elves…! Prince, we must head to the Fairy Realm at once!
m920044.ちっ、王子め、追いついたのか……。\nちょうどいい。まとめて滅ぼしてくれる……！: Tch, Prince, you've caught up… Perfect. We'll wipe you out all at once… Go! Monsters!
m920044.ですが、私はなんとしてもミスリル鉱を、\n集めなければ……。: But I must gather the mithril ore, no matter what…
m920044.ですがミスリル鉱を狙うものがいるのは事実です。\n先ほどのダークエルフが魔物を使:
Still, it's true that someone's after the mithril.
Those Dark Elves just now were using monsters to gather it… they must be up to something.
m920044.では一斉にミスリル鉱の採集に取り掛かれ！: Then begin harvesting the mithril ore at once!
m920044.では王子、さっそくダークエルフの後を追いましょう。: Then, Prince, let's chase after those Dark Elves right away.
m920044.どうやらそいつはゴーレムと呼ばれる古代兵器でな。\n巨大で頑強な体を持ち、一体で: It's an ancient weapon called a Golem. Huge, tough, and powerful enough to wipe out a nation on its own.
m920044.な、なんだと！！ おのれダークエルフめ……！\n確かにミスリル鉱は魔の力に反応す:
Wh—what!! You damned Dark Elf…!
Sure enough, mithril reacts to demonic power.
m920044.なっ……！ お前たちだな！ ミスリル鉱を奪おうと\nしている奴ってのは！！: Wh—! It's you! The ones trying to steal the mithril ore!!
m920044.なんとか撃退することができましたね……。\nさぁ、急ぎ先へ進みましょう。: We managed to drive them off… Now, let's press on quickly.
m920044.はい。そのようです。\nしかし、ダークエルフを見失ってしまいましたか。\n企みを: Yes, that's what it looks like. But we've lost sight of the Dark Elf. We should resume our search to stop their scheme.
m920044.ひとまず、これまでに集めたミスリル鉱を\nお渡ししたいですし、いったん共に王城に: First, I'd like to give you the mithril we've gathered, and then let's return to the royal castle together.
m920044.ふぅ……、助かりましたわ。\n感謝いたします。\nそれにしても、あなた方はなぜこ: Phew… that was close. Thank you. But why are you all in this cave…?
m920044.ふは、は……、ふはははっ。はははははッ……！！\nおめでたい奴らだ。これで終わり: Heh… ha… hahahaha! Hahahahaha!! Congratulations, you fools. You think this is the end? The battle you fought was only against an unfinished prototype.
m920044.まぁ助けてもらった礼だ。\nダークエルフが作りだそうとしている\n兵器について教: Consider this a thank-you for the rescue. I'll tell you about the weapon the Dark Elf's trying to create.
m920044.もしかして……。王子、ダークエルフの狙いは\nそれかもしれません。\nもしそうな: Could it be… Prince, the Dark Elves might be after that. If so, we have to stop them from making a weapon!
m920044.もちろんです。\n私たちと共に魔物と戦っていただける方への\n協力は惜しみません: Of course. We'll spare no effort to aid anyone who fights monsters alongside us.
m920044.やはりダークエルフが魔物を使って\nミスリル鉱を集めているのは本当みたいですね。: It seems the Dark Elf really is using monsters to gather mithril after all.
m920044.やはり彼らの目的は……。\nここは何としてでも阻止しなければいけません。: So that's their goal… We have to stop them at any cost.
m920044.わたくし、神官戦士ですの。\n癒しの魔法も使えるので、心配はご無用ですわ。\nそ:
I'm a priest-warrior, you know.
I can cast healing magic, so you have nothing to worry about.
I'll see you later then…
m920044.わたくしは一人で探索いたしますわね。\nその方が効率もよいですし……。:
I'll go explore on my own.
That'll be more efficient, after all…
m920044.わたくしは活性化して強くなった魔物と戦うためには、\nミスリル鉱を使った上質な武: I thought that to fight the newly-activated, stronger monsters, I'd need high-quality weapons made from mithril.
m920044.ギャギャ……ッ！\nオマエタチ、敵……！！:
Gya-gya…!
You there, you're the enemy…!!
m920044.セラさん！ 加勢いたします！: Sera! I'll lend you my support!
m920044.ダークエルフとミスリル……。\n魔物とも何かしらの関係があるのかもしれません。\: Dark Elves and mithril… perhaps they're connected to the monsters somehow. Prince, we should continue investigating this cave.
m920044.ダークエルフは私たちに任せ、セラさんは\n引き続きミスリル鉱の探索を続けてくださ: Dark Elf, leave it to us. Sera, keep searching for the mithril.
m920044.チッ、邪魔な奴らだ。だがミスリル鉱は渡さん……！\n貴様らなど排除してくれる！！: Tch, pesky insects. But I won't hand over the mithril ore… I'll eliminate you all!!
m920044.ミスリル鉱で作った武器が完成した暁には、\nあなたたちの魔物討伐をお手伝いできま: When I finish a weapon made from mithril, I can help you with monster hunting…
m920044.ミスリル鉱の使い方を教えたら用無し扱いされて、\nダークエルフ共に仕返しするつも: I taught them how to use mithril, got tossed aside, and then—thinking I'd get revenge on the Dark Elf—I woke up that sleeping mech in this cave…
m920044.ミスリル鉱は希少ですからここまで\n採りにきたんですの。: Mithril is rare, so I came all the way here to mine it.
m920044.先に進むしかないようですね。\n王子、参りましょう。: Looks like we have to press on. Prince, let's go.
m920044.先の戦闘でみた魔物はそれだったのですか……。: So that was the monster we saw in the previous battle…
m920044.兵士の報告によると、もう少しでこの地点に\nミスリルゴーレムがやってくるとのこと: According to the soldiers, a mithril golem is about to arrive at this spot. Prince, let's intercept it.
m920044.助かりましたわ。\nわたくしの名はセラ。では、参ります！: That was close. I am Sera. Then, onward!
m920044.大きな音がしたのでもしやと駆けつけましたが……。\nその様子だとダークエルフの企: I heard a huge noise and rushed over… From what I can see, we've managed to thwart the Dark Elf's scheme.
m920044.妖精郷のエルフの使者から、この洞窟に\nダークエルフが出入りしているとの報告を\: We received a report from an elf envoy of the Fairy Realm that Dark Elves have been coming in and out of this cave.
m920044.怒りで我を忘れていたとはいえ、\nいろいろ巻き込んですまなかったな！: I let my anger blind me, and dragged everyone into this mess. My bad.
m920044.我々にミスリル鉱を渡せ！\n最強の力となりうる兵器を、我らが手に……！: Hand over the mithril ore! Let us claim the weapon that could become the ultimate power!
m920044.我らの全戦力をもって、お前たちを\n滅ぼしてやる。覚悟しろ……！: With all our forces, we'll annihilate you. Brace yourself…!
m920044.我らの手中にある内の一つ、完成体は妖精郷に\n向けて、すでに進軍を開始していたの: One of the units we have is a fully-finished model heading for the Fairy Realm. Our plan is already complete.
m920044.敵の残りの体力に気を付けつつ、\n対処したほうがよさそうです。: We should keep an eye on the enemy's remaining HP and deal with it accordingly.
m920044.敵襲！ 前方より敵がこちらに接近中！: Enemy attack! Enemies are approaching from ahead!
m920044.王子、魔物たちがこちらに向かってきています！\n応戦しましょう！: Prince, the monsters are heading our way! Let's engage!
m920044.私たちは敵ではありません。\n共に魔物と戦いましょう！: We're not enemies. Let's fight the monsters together!
m920044.私たちは王子の指揮の下、それを調査しに参りました。\nセラさんはなぜこのようなと: Under your command, Prince, we came to investigate. Sera, why are you alone in a place like this…?
m920044.純度の高いものとなれば、魔の力に触れたことに\nよって魔物化までする物もでてきた: When it's pure enough, exposure to that power can even turn things into monsters.
m920044.結局あの魔物は何だったのでしょうか。: In the end, what exactly was that monster?
m920044.落ち着いてください。\n私たちは略奪をしに来たわけじゃありません。\nなにか守る:
Calm down.
We didn't come here to loot.
Is there something you're protecting?
m920044.行ってしまいました……。\n王子、私たちも参りましょう。:
She's gone…
Prince, we should follow her.
m920044.見たことのない敵……。\n魔物とは、違うようですが……？: I've never seen this enemy… It doesn't seem like a monster, though…?
m920044.見るからに硬そうな魔物ですね。\nこちらの攻撃が通りにくいかもしれません。:
It looks like a really tough creature.
Our attacks might have a hard time getting through.
m920044.起こし方がまずかったのか\n暴走状態で起動してしまってな。\nえらい目にあったわ: Guess I messed up the awakening, ‘cause it went berserk. That really gave me a hard time.
m920044.過酷な状況ではありますが、戦うしかないようです。\n王子、戦闘の準備を！: The situation's harsh, but we have no choice but to fight. Prince, prepare for battle!
m920044.魔物たちも集めているようで、\nなかなか見つけられないのですけれど……。: The monsters also seem to be gathering it, so it's hard to find, but…

m920073.――えぇ！？ 妖怪がいっぱい！？\nど、どういうことなのでしょうか？: —What!? So many monsters!? Wh-what's going on?
m920073.――ぐはぁッ！？ \nそ、そんな……ばか、な……。\nこの私が……圧倒されている:
—Guh—!?
No... this... idiot... I... am being overwhelmed...!?
m920073.――ついにぬらりひょんが逝きましたか。\n妖怪の総大将の末路が、ああも滑稽とは…:
—So at last Nura-Ryou has perished.
The fate of the great commander of yokai is so absurd...
How fleeting the present is... hehehe...
m920073.――ッ！？\nあれは……死んだ武士達が物の怪の仕業で\n魔物へと変えられてしまっ: —!? That looks like… the dead samurai transformed into monsters by some spirit's doing.
m920073.――ッ！？\nそこにいるのは分かっているぞ！\n出てこい、妖怪総大将ぬらりひょん: ———! I know he's right there! Come out, Great General Nurarihyon!
m920073.――話途中に御免。\nご報告にござる。ぬらりひょん率いる\n妖怪軍団が、都へ進軍: ――Excuse me for interrupting. Report: the yokai army led by Nurarihyon is marching on the capital.
m920073.――酒呑童子様ッ！！\nぬらりひょんを倒した王子という人間が、\nここへと向かっ: Four Heavenly Kings of Heavy Water: ――Lord Shuten-dōji!! The human who defeated Nurarihyon is heading this way!
m920073.…………バカめェッ！！\nそんな古臭い札で、\nこの俺が封印出来ると思ったかァ！:
…You fool!!
You think an old-fashioned talisman can seal me?!
m920073.…………邪気が、完全に消えた……。\n口惜しいが、逃げられてしまったでござるな。:
……The evil has vanished completely…
Regrettable, but he's escaped.
m920073.……ありがとう！\n貴方達となら、きっと上手くいく気がする……。\n何としてでも: …Thank you! With you by my side, I'm sure we can succeed. We'll crush Nura Rihyon's ambitions no matter what!
m920073.……くそっ。アンナさん、ここはお任せいたします。\n私は急ぎ酒呑童子の元へ向かい:
...Damn it. Anna, I'll leave this to you.
I'll rush to Shuten-dōji and strike him down before he fully regains his strength.
m920073.……くっ。\nあそこまで酒呑童子を追い詰めておいて\n逃がしてしまうなんて……一:
…Damn.
After driving the Wine Cellar Boy to the brink, I let him get away… A blunder I'll live with forever…
m920073.……ここは、一度酒呑童子様の許に……、\n我等四天王の力を……結集させ……、\n: Four Heavenly Kings of Heavy Water: …Here, we'll once again go to Lord Shuten-dōji… gather the Four Kings' power… and we'll surely… crush you humans…!!
m920073.……ですが、完全なる力を取り戻すには\nやはり最後の一片が必要かと……。: Shunrai Four Heavenly Kings: …However, to fully restore your power we still need that final fragment…
m920073.……なるほどね……ふふ。\nまったく、とんだお人好し達だわ。:
…I see… hehe.
You're all such good-hearted fools.
m920073.……やけに静かね。\n都に妖怪が集まっているのは\n間違いないのに……。:
…It's oddly quiet.
Yokai are definitely gathering in the capital, but…
m920073.……オオォォオオ……。\n……人間……にん、げぇぇん……オォォォオ……。\n我ら: …Oooo… Humans… gaaa… Oooo… Join us… and die…
m920073.……了解致した。\n鬼共！ 出陣するぞ！\n（チッ、おいぼれが偉そうにしやがって:
…Understood.
Demons! To battle!
(Heh, that fool is acting all high-and-mighty…)
m920073.……彼女には、果たすべき使命があり、\n今はこうして私と行動を別にしていますが、: …She has a duty to fulfill, and right now she's acting apart from me. Because of her temperament I'm worried she's taking unnecessary risks…
m920073.……王子、ごめんなさい……。\n酒呑童子は力を取り戻してしまったわ……。\n私で: …Prince, I'm sorry… Shuten-dōji has regained his power… I can't possibly stand up to him… Ouch…
m920073.……間に合わなかったか！\nくそっ……。\n全ての封印が解かれてしまったわ……。: ???: …We weren't fast enough! Damn it… All the seals have been broken…
m920073.「アレ」を使うのですね！\n総員、引き上げじゃあ！: So we're using “that,” huh! Everyone, fall back!
m920073.「妖怪の総大将を自称しておけば、\nのらりくらりとした単純な妖怪は意のままに操れ: “If you claim to be the Grand General of monsters, you can manipulate simple, sluggish monsters at will. The larger your influence, the more monsters will look up to you.”
m920073.「鬼切」の使い手だと……ッ！？\n我ら鬼の一族をあのような場所に封じた、\n忌々:
The wielder of "Oni-Kiri"...!?

m920086.ここですね、河童が暴れているというのは。: So this is the place where the Kappa are rampaging.
m920086.ここでの目的は果たしました。それでは……。: Our purpose here is fulfilled. Then...
m920086.ここ最近、矢が全く通らないほど硬い魔物が\n現れるようになった上、連日の雨で視界: Lately, monsters so hard that arrows can't pierce have started appearing, and with the constant rain our visibility is poor, making it impossible to thin their numbers…
m920086.こちらですか、弓矢の通じない魔物が現れたというのは。: So this is it—the monster that arrows can't pierce has appeared.
m920086.このままにはしておけませんね。\n王子、急ぎ封印の島へと向かいましょう！: We can't let it continue like this. Prince, let's hurry to the sealed island!
m920086.このまま捨て置くわけに行かぬのは帝国も同様だ。\n……むしろ被害の大きい我が国こ:
We can't just leave it be; the Empire feels the same.
…In fact, our nation, which suffered the most, should be the one to act first.
m920086.この大量のキョンシー、\n一体どれ程の人が屍解仙の犠牲に…………。: This horde of Jiangshi… how many lives have become Shikai-sen's sacrifices...?
m920086.この欠片から、ハクノカミ様の御力を感じル……。: I can feel Lord Hakunokami's power emanating from this fragment…
m920086.この雨雲、少々厄介そうですね。\n王子、雨が降っている時の河童は、\n普段よりも:
Those rain clouds look troublesome.
Prince, I've heard Kappa are stronger when it's raining.
m920086.これさえあれば憎きエルフ共を\n根絶やしにできよう。やれ、トレント共よ！\n妖精: With this, we can eradicate those hateful elves. Come, Treants! Destroy the Fairy Village!
m920086.これで犠牲になった人達を弔う事も出来ます……。: Now we can also honor the people who were sacrificed…
m920086.これは……まさか、ハクノカミ様の封印を守ル、\n龍玉の欠片でハ……。: This… could it be a fragment of the Dragon Jewel that seals Lord Hakunokami…?
m920086.こんな時に……。\nレオナさんとサーベインさんはまだ揉めている様ですし、\nここ: At a time like this… Leona and Sabein are still at odds, so it looks like we have to fight alone, Prince.
m920086.させません！ 王子、龍玉の欠片を取り戻し\nトレント達の暴走を止めましょう！: We won't let that happen! Prince, let's retrieve the dragon-crystal fragment and stop the Treants' rampage!
m920086.しかし、その封印が破られた今、\n目覚めの時は刻一刻と近づきつつあるようだ。\n: But now that seal's been broken, the time of awakening draws ever closer with each passing moment. I can feel his presence growing stronger each day.
m920086.すまない、合流が遅くなったな、王子。\nサーベイン、あれが\nお前の言っていた古: Sorry for the delay in joining you, Prince. Sabein, that's the ancient dragon you were talking about, right?
m920086.そういえば、さっきの魔物が\n何やら欠片のようなものを落としましたが\nこれは一: Speaking of which, the monster just now dropped something that looked like a fragment. I wonder what it is.
m920086.そうか、それは残念じゃのう……。\nまぁよい、馳走はまたの機会にするとしよう。: I see, that's unfortunate… Very well, we'll save the feast for another time.
m920086.そうですね……それにしても、まさかあの屍解仙が\nあれ程の武術を体得しているとは: That's true… But still, who would have thought that the Corpse-Dissolving Immortal had mastered such martial arts?
m920086.そのような方がこの地で眠られているとは……レオナさん、\nサーベインさん、貴重な: To think such a being rests here… Leona, Sabein, thank you for the valuable information.
m920086.その名も……「雷爪キョンシー」よ！\nカッカッカ！ まさかキョンシーが\n雷を操: And its name... "Thunderclaw Jiangshi"! Ka-ka-ka! Who would have dreamed that a Jiangshi could command lightning?
m920086.その通りですね。そのためにもまず、\nこの地を天使達より取り戻さねばなりません。: Exactly. To do that, we must first reclaim this land from the angels. Prince, prepare for battle!
m920086.それだけサーベインさん達竜人族の方にとっては、\nハクノカミ様とは特別な存在なの: That just shows how special Hakunokami is to you dragon-folk, Sabein and the others.
m920086.それではよろしく頼むぞ。\nさぁ、まずは寝床を用意せい。わらわはまだ眠り足りん。: Then I count on you. First, prepare a bed for me. I still need more sleep. Wake me if you need anything.
m920086.そんなの気にしないで！ 困ったときはお互い様よ！: Don't worry about it! When one of us is in trouble, we help each other!
m920086.そんな言葉は知らん！\nいい加減に離さんか！: I don't know any such saying! Stop this already!
m920086.そんな～。龍玉の欠片を集めても、\nほこらに戻せなかったら意味がないですよ～！: Oh, no… Even if we gather the crystal fragments, it's pointless if we can't bring them back to the shrine!
m920086.ただの気紛れであろう。\n古代龍様の御心ハ\n誰にも計り知れるものではないのダ。: Just a whim, perhaps. The Ancient Dragon's will is beyond anyone's comprehension.
m920086.だからハクノカミ、その本人じゃと言うておる。: So it's Hakunokami, the very person themselves, I say.
m920086.だから何度も判ったと言っているだろう！ \nえぇい、いい加減に離さんか！: I've told you over and over again! …Enough, stop dragging this out!
m920086.ったく、なんつー数いやがんだ。……っておい！ \nハク……ノカミ？\nとかいうの: Good grief, what a number this is… Hey! Hak…no…kami? Whatever that is, it's following us!
m920086.どうやら後方の海からも敵が来ているようだ。\n我々はそちらを担当しよう。サーベイ: It seems enemies are also coming from the sea behind us. We'll handle that side. Sabein, having you here would be a hassle. Come with us!
m920086.どちら様でしょうか？ \n尻尾に鱗……竜人の方のようですが、\nサーベインさんの:
Who might you be?
You have a scaled tail… you look like a draconic being.
Are you an acquaintance of Sabein?
m920086.な、なんだト！ \n再びハクノカミ様の島を踏み荒らそうとハなんと愚かな！\nお前: Wh-what? …You dare think of trampling Hakunokami's island again? How foolish! You lot, prepare a ship at once!
m920086.なに、欠片が集まれば、\nそのうち力も自然に戻るじゃろうて。\nわらわの事は心配: Once the fragments are gathered, my power will naturally return. Don't worry about me.
m920086.ならヌ、ならヌ、ならヌ！！！！\nハクノカミ様はこちらから刺激でもせぬ限り、\n: Then—then—then!!!! As long as we don't provoke Hakunokami, it won't recklessly harm the surface!
m920086.なるほど。「竜」は長寿ではあるが、\n同種族や他種族との争いで命を落とす事も多い:
I see. Dragons live long, yet many die in conflicts with their own kind or other races.
Surviving that long is proof of strength, indeed.
m920086.なんじゃここは。まったく、\n狭苦しすぎて尻尾も伸ばせんぞ。: What is this place? Good grief, it's so cramped I can't even stretch my tail.
m920086.なんとかトレント達の暴走は落ち着いたようですね。\n龍玉の欠片も取り返す事ができ: It looks like we've managed to calm the Treants' rampage. We've also recovered the dragon-crystal fragment.
m920086.ぬ、ぬらりの姉さんじゃねぇか！？\nお、お許しくだせェ！: N… it's Nurarihyon's sister!? P-please forgive me!
m920086.ぬぬぅ、折角作ったキョンシー達を\nよくもやってくれたのう……。: Huh-huh, you actually dared to mess with the Jiangshi I painstakingly crafted...
m920086.はい、その際には是非ご馳走に与りますね。\n王子、引き続き龍玉の欠片の収集を急ぎ:
Yes, when that time comes, we'll be sure to treat you.
Prince, let's continue to hurry in collecting the dragon crystal fragments!
m920086.はい、ヒエンさん、よろしくお願いします。\nそれでは王子、引き続き欠片の回収を…: Yes, Hien, thank you. Then, Prince, let's continue gathering the fragments…
m920086.はい。ですが、ひとまず屍解仙の術から\nキョンシー達を解放する事はできました。: Yes. For now, though, we've managed to free the Jiangshi from the Corpse-Dissolving Immortal's technique.
m920086.はい。必ずやこの拳にて屍解仙を討ち、\nキョンシーとされた方々の無念、晴らしてみ: Right. I'll crush the Corpse-Dissolving Immortal with my fists and avenge the Jiangshi's lingering regrets!
m920086.はい。王国領内へと水を運ぶ水路、\n以前までであれば魔物の襲撃も少なく\nカズハ: Yes. The waterway that brings water into the kingdom—until recently, monster attacks were few and my bow was more than enough to handle them…
m920086.はい！ この地の防衛は、\nカズハ達にお任せください！: Yes! Leave the defense of this land to us!
m920086.ひ、ひぇぇ～……。なんですかあの大っきい龍は……。\nあんなの、まともに戦って\: H-heeey… what's that huge dragon? There's no way we can fight something like that!
m920086.ひ、卑怯だと！？ 小娘如きが調子に乗りよって……。\nふん、よかろう！ わしを地: Cowardice, you say!? A little girl getting all high-and-mighty… Fine! If you can bring me down to the ground, I'll show you the true essence of martial skill combined with divine power!
m920086.ふはははは！ ケラウノス様から授かりし\n龍玉の欠片、素晴らしいではないか！: Hahaha! The fragment of the dragon crystal bestowed upon us by Lord Keraunos—splendid!
m920086.ふむ。トレントの奴ら、\n何やら凄まじい自然の力にあてられて\n暴走してしまって: Hmm. Those Treants appear to have gone berserk, driven by some overwhelming natural power.
m920086.ふん、別にどっちでもいいさ。\n飛んでても、地上に降りても、\n俺の魔法剣に隙は: Hmph, I don't care either way. Whether you fly or stay grounded, my magic blade leaves no opening!
m920086.へ、へぇ！ \nすいませんでしたぁーーー！\nこっからは、総大将とよばせていただ:
Heh, okay!
I'm sorry!!!
From now on, please call me Grand Marshal!
m920086.ほこらから大量の魔物たちが……いえ、王子アレを！: A massive swarm of monsters is pouring out of the shrine… no, Prince, look out!
m920086.まぁ、どういう訳かその結界は破られ\nこうして目覚めてしまった訳じゃが。\n一体: Well, for some reason that barrier was broken and I've awakened like this. What on earth is happening?
m920086.まぁよい。全てを貫く天雷には及ばずとも、\n雷爪キョンシーの前には鎧など意味をな: Well, no matter. Even if it can't match the all-piercing heavenly thunder, that Thunderclaw Jiangshi will render armor useless. Unless they have resistance to divine power, they won't stand a chance. Ka-ka-ka!
m920086.まさに水を得た魚と言った所ですね。: Exactly—a fish in water, you could say.
m920086.まだ言うカ。ハクノカミ様とは蒼銀に輝く鱗を持ち、\n清流の如きしなやかな尾には金: Still you say so. Hakunokami-sama has silver-blue shimmering scales, a tail as supple as a clear stream wrapped in golden hair, the great…
m920086.まるで私達についてくるように……\n一体何をお考えなのでしょうね。: It's as if they're coming along with us… I wonder what they're thinking.
m920086.み、皆さん。……はい！ \nよーし、力を合わせて頑張りましょう！: Everyone… Yes! Alright, let's work together and give it our all!
m920086.やれい、我がキョンシー軍団よ！ \nその人間達を殺し\n新たな研究材料を手に入れ: Come forth, my Jiangshi legion! Slay those humans and bring me fresh research material!
m920086.わらわが眠りにつく前、人間と魔物共が\n小競りあってた頃じゃが……どんくらい昔じ: Before I fell asleep, humans and monsters were still squabbling… I can't recall exactly how long ago that was.
m920086.わらわの力の大部分を龍玉に封じておった故、\nそれが破壊されてしまった今、使える: Since most of my power was sealed in the Dragon Orb, now that it's shattered I can only wield enough strength to fight as a mortal.
m920086.アンナ、また魔物が現れないとも限らないわ。\n私達は引き続きここの守りに努めるわ: Anna, another monster could show up at any moment. We'll keep guarding this place.
m920086.ギャッギャッ！ コノ欠片アレバ、\n王子タオセル。オレタチ、カタイ。:
Gya gya! If you have this fragment,
Prince, you'll die. We're tough.
m920086.サーベイン、古代龍とお前達竜人とでは何が違うのだ？: Sabein, what's the difference between the ancient dragon and you draconians?
m920086.サーベインさんの言っていた言葉が気になりますね。\n確かに、ハクノカミ様が私達に: I'm curious about what Sabein mentioned. Indeed, we haven't received any reports of Hakunokami attacking us.
m920086.ダークエルフや天使まで……。\n一体中で何が起こっているのでしょう。: Even dark elves and angels… what on earth is happening here?
m920086.ハクノカミ様には攻撃を加えないよう\n慎重なご采配をお願いいたします。: Please proceed with caution and avoid striking Hakunokami.
m920086.ハクノカミ様の名を騙るとは……ふム、\nまぁハクノカミ様の御姿を拝見したばかり、:
Claiming the name Hakunokami… hmm.
Well, having just beheld Hakunokami-sama, I can understand feeling a bit awestruck.
m920086.ハクノカミ様の御怒りを鎮めるニは、各地へと散っタ\n龍玉の欠片を集め、再び台座へ: To calm Hakunokami's wrath, we must gather the scattered Dragon Jewel fragments and return them to the pedestal.
m920086.ハクノカミ様の御考えも気になりますが、\n今は欠片を集め、一刻も早く龍玉を\nほ: We're curious about Hakunokami's thoughts, but right now we must gather the fragments and get the Dragon Orb into the shrine as quickly as possible.
m920086.ハクノカミ様は、長き眠りに就かれる際、\n龍玉という宝珠に自身の力を分け与え、\: When Lord Hakunokami entered his long slumber, he split his power into a jewel called the Dragon Jewel, using it as the foundation of the barrier that seals him.
m920086.ム……この気配はハクノカミ様？ \n……いヤ、\nそれにしてハ余りにモ弱イ……。:
Mmm… is that presence Hakunokami?
…No,
but it's far too weak…
m920086.リルケさん、ありがとうございます。\n軍備を増加するよう手配はしておきますので。: Thank you, Rilke. I'll arrange to boost our forces.
m920086.レオナさん、ご無事で何よりです。\nしかし海中に消えたとは……。:
Leona, I'm glad you're safe.
But disappearing into the sea…
m920086.下級の魔物なのに、私の矢が\n全く通じませんでした。ショックです……。: Even though they're low-rank monsters, my arrows couldn't pierce them at all. It's shocking…
m920086.中々良いものを貰ったぞ。\nこれさえあればエルフ共を……ふはは！: I've gotten a pretty good haul. With this, the elves… hahahaha!
m920086.久しぶりじゃのうアンナ。妖精郷を守護する\n超絶美少女プリチー巫女姫ププル様とは: It's been a while, Anna. I'm the ultra-beautiful priestess-princess Pupuru, protector of the Fairy Village.
m920086.今ので全ての敵を倒したようですが……。\nケラウノスはすでに去った後のようですね: It looks like we just took down all the enemies… Keraunos seems to have already left.
m920086.今ので魔物は粗方倒せたようです。\n龍玉の欠片を所持していた魔物もいたようですね: That should have taken care of most of the monsters. Looks like one of them was carrying a dragon crystal fragment.
m920086.伝令！ 前方よりマーマン達が接近中との事！: Messenger! Mermen are approaching from ahead!
m920086.何か知っているのか、サーベイン。: You know something about this, Sabein?
m920086.何をきょとんとした顔をしておる？ \nもっと嬉しそうな顔をせんかい。: Why the puzzled look? Put on a happier face!
m920086.余計な邪魔が入りましたが、\n古代龍を封印していた龍玉は既に破壊しました。\n目: Unnecessary interference has arrived, but the Dragon Jewel that sealed the ancient dragon has already been shattered. The awakened ancient dragon destroying the material world is only a matter of time.
m920086.俺達は長い年月の間にこの姿に変化したガ、\nこれは弱さの表れでもあるのダ。強大な:
We have taken this form over the ages, which shows our weakness;
but because we possess great power, we can continue unchanged since antiquity.
m920086.先ほどの戦いぶりは見せて貰った。人の身でありながら\n中々やるようじゃが、こうし: I saw your fighting just now. For a human, you're doing quite well, and that's enough for me to be convinced you're somehow related to that one.
m920086.全く……すぐにこの血判状に名を記せ！: Honestly… just write your name on the blood oath right now!
m920086.全く、そのような少数の手勢で神を止めようなど、\n人間とは本当に度し難い程に愚物: Truly, trying to stop a god with such a handful of troops—humans are utterly incorrigible fools.
m920086.全くうるさい連中じゃのう……。じゃがちょうど良い、\n新たに作ったキョンシーの力: Such noisy chatter… Very well, it's the perfect chance to test the power of my newly-created Jiangshi.
m920086.全く最近の若い奴は……まぁ構わん。\nひとまずどこか休める場所へ案内せい。わらわ:
Young folks these days… well, never mind.
Take them to somewhere they can rest. I still haven't had enough sleep; my mind is still a bit drowsy.
m920086.全て、主の仰せのままに……。: All according to the master's command…
m920086.凄まじい自然の力……恐らく、\n龍玉の欠片の力とみて間違いはないでしょうね。: Such a massive natural force… it must be the power of the dragon-crystal fragment.
m920086.判りました。道中どうかお気を付けください。\n王子、戦闘のご準備を！: Understood. Please take care on the road. Prince, prepare for battle!
m920086.力を分け与えた龍玉ハ、云わばハクノカミ様の\n分身とも呼べる物だ。何かあろうもの: The Dragon Jewel, which he gave his power to, is essentially a manifestation of Lord Hakunokami himself. If anything were to happen, he surely wouldn't stay peacefully asleep.
m920086.千年前？ ……なんじゃ、たったそれだけしか\n経っておらんかったのか。まぁその頃: A thousand years? …What, that's all that's passed? Well, I do remember someone much like you leading people back then.
m920086.古代龍……伝承でしか聞いた事のない存在だったけど、\nまさか、本当に実在してたな:
The ancient dragon… I'd only heard of it in legends,
but to think it actually exists.
m920086.古代龍様は、千年戦争よりモ以前、\n世界創生の頃より存在すル最古の「龍」。:
The ancient dragon predates the Thousand-Year War,
existing since the world's creation as the oldest “dragon.”
m920086.各地で降り続く雨は欠片の力の暴走が原因じゃ。\nそれに関しても欠片を集めさえすれ: The endless rain across the lands is caused by the fragments' runaway energy. Gather them, and I can control it. Rest assured.
m920086.各地にて、普段では考えられぬホドに硬質化した\n魔物が見つかっているとの事ダ。\: Reports say that, across the lands, monsters have hardened to an unprecedented degree—likely affected by the fragments.
m920086.如何に海中であろうと、あれ程の巨体が\n海中を泳いでいれば何かしらの気配も\nあ: Even underwater, a creature of that size must leave some trace if it's swimming around.
m920086.少し時間は貰うけど、私達エンチャンターなら\n弓矢に魔法を付与する事だってできる: Give us a moment, and as Enchanters we can imbue arrows with magic. When the time comes, count on us.
m920086.屍を弄ぶ邪仙とは言え、仙人を名乗る程には\n数多の学門、武門に通じ功夫を積んでき: Even though he's a rogue who toys with corpses, calling himself a sage suggests he's studied countless schools of thought and martial disciplines.
m920086.屍解仙、覚悟なさい！ 私の積んだ、\n功夫で必ずやお前を討ってみせます！！: Shikai-sen, prepare yourself! With my kung-fu, I'll definitely bring you down!!
m920086.左様にござる。中には異様に硬い\n河童も見られるとのこと……龍玉の欠片を\n所持: Indeed. They've reported some unusually tough Kappa… It's likely they're carrying dragon crystal fragments.
m920086.帝国軍の多くは此度の豪雨の対応に追われている。\nこのような少数の派兵しかできず:
Most Imperial troops are occupied dealing with the recent downpours.
We can only send a small detachment, sorry about that.
m920086.恐らく血判状を書いていない河童がいたのでしょう。\n私の父、ぬらりひょんが没した:
Probably some Kappa never signed the blood oath.
After my father Nurarihyon passed, I've heard some Kappa sided with the Shuten-dōji.
m920086.我が僕たちよ、龍玉の欠片を用い\nその人間達を滅しなさい。私は天界へと戻ります。: My minions, use the Dragon Jewel fragments to annihilate those humans. I shall return to the heavens.
m920086.我ら帝国にても引き続き欠片の収集、捜索は\n行っていく。情報は逐次共有して行こウ: The Empire will continue gathering and searching for fragments, sharing information as we go. Then, let's begin the operation!
m920086.我ら帝国も収集ニかかってはいるのだガ、\nやはり時間が足りナイ。貴公らにモ\n回: Our Empire is also working on the collection, but time is still short. We'd like to ask for your help in retrieving them...
m920086.我ら竜人の始祖たる「竜」とは異なるが、\n最古の龍たる、ハクノカミ様への崇拝の念: It differs from the “dragons” who are our ancestors, but the reverence for the oldest dragon, Hakunokami, is shared by all draconians.
m920086.拙者は引き続きこの地にて、\n欠片をもつ魔物の捜索に当たるでござる。: I will continue to search this area for monsters bearing fragments.
m920086.本当です。一体どこにいっちゃったんでしょう……。: That's true. Where on earth could they have gone…?
m920086.欠片も随分と集まってきましたね～。\nこの調子でいけば、じきに全て集められそうで: The fragments have really started piling up, haven't they? At this rate, we should be able to collect them all soon!
m920086.死体を弄ばれ、弔う事すら許されないとは……。\n王子、必ずや屍解仙を倒し、犠牲に: To have their corpses desecrated, denied even a proper burial… Prince, we must defeat Shikai-sen and free those souls from his sorcery!
m920086.火やら水やら木やら自然の力も色々あるんじゃが、\nトレントは草木を司る守護者じゃ: There are many forces—fire, water, wood—but the Treants are guardians of plants. If you give them any other power, they just get confused.
m920086.王子……すまない……我々がいながら\nみすみす龍玉を破壊されてしまうとは……。: Prince... I'm sorry... we were here, yet the Dragon Jewel was destroyed right before our eyes...
m920086.王子、ハクノカミ様の封印に\n何かあったのかもしれません。\n急ぎ封印へと向かい: Prince, something may have happened to Lord Hakunokami's seal. We should hurry to the seal.
m920086.王子、今回の件についてだが、一応の\n解決方法の目途は立ったのでその事を伝えに来: Prince, regarding this matter, we've finally got a viable solution, so I came to tell you.
m920086.王子、天使達が退いていきます。\n無事島を守り抜けたようです。:
Prince, the angels are retreating.
It looks like we've safely defended the island.
m920086.王子、急ぎ拠点へ戻り、\nこの未曾有の危機に対し対策を練りましょう。: Prince, let's hurry back to the base and devise a plan against this unprecedented crisis.
m920086.王子、急ぎ龍が出現しているとの\n海域へ向かいましょう！: Prince, we must hurry to the sea where the dragon's been sighted!
m920086.王子、敵の勢いが弱まっていきます！: Prince, the enemy's momentum is waning!
m920086.王子、此度は手間をかけさせてしまいすみません。\nあの河童たちが持っていた龍玉の:
Prince, I'm sorry for the trouble this time.
Here are the dragon crystal fragments the Kappa had, please take them.
m920086.王子、河童が向かってきます！\n雨が降っている間は、河童の攻撃に\n注意してくだ:
Prince, the Kappa are coming!
Be careful of their attacks while it's raining.
m920086.王子、見張り台の兵より前方に降雨の気配があるとの事。\n降雨時は飛び道具の射程が:
Prince, the sentries report rain gathering ahead.
Rain reduces projectile range, so be careful.
Consider using the onmyōji as well.
m920086.王子、龍玉の欠片を所持していると思わしき魔物は、\nまだまだ各地で報告が上がって: Prince, reports keep coming in of monsters that seem to be carrying dragon-crystal fragments all over the region. We should hurry and take them down.
m920086.王子よ、忘れておるかもしれんが、トレント共は\n多少の傷であればすぐ治ってしまう: Prince, you may have forgotten, but Treants heal from minor wounds instantly. Be careful.
m920086.王子！ あの魔物、私の矢がほとんど通りません！\n弾かれてしまいます！:
Prince! Those monsters, my arrows barely get through!
They bounce right off!
m920086.生半可な物理攻撃では通用しナイ。\n魔法等何らかの手段ヲ講じた方が良いだろうナ。: Ordinary physical attacks won't cut it. You'll need magic or some other means.
m920086.皆さん、救援に来ていただいて\n本当に助かりました。ありがとうございます。: Everyone, thank you so much for coming to our aid. We really appreciate it.
m920086.神だの人間だの悪魔だのにはさほど興味はない。\nじゃがまぁ、わらわの分身でもあっ: I'm not really interested in gods, humans, or demons. But, as a token for gathering the fragments of my Dragon Orb—my own avatar—I'll do that.
m920086.種族間での争いなんぞ茶飯事、どーでも\n良くて放っといたんじゃが、その頃どっかの: Inter-species conflicts were everyday stuff, I didn't care and left them be, but around that time some god got all noisy about joining in to wipe out humanity.
m920086.突っ込みもなしとは、つれんのう。まぁよい。\nダークエルフの連中、何やら強烈な力: No need for a retort, you fool. Fine. The Dark Elves gave the Treants a stone that radiates a terrible power.
m920086.突入するなら今が好機ですね！\n王子、急ぎほこらの中へと向かいましょう！: If we're going to charge in, now's the perfect time! Prince, let's hurry to the shrine's interior.
m920086.見えたぞ。\nハクノカミ様が眠られているのハ、あのほこらダ。: I see it. That shrine is where Lord Hakunokami is sleeping.
m920086.触らぬ古代龍様にたたり無しという\n言葉を知らぬのカ！？: Don't you know the saying “the untouched ancient dragon brings no curse”?
m920086.詳しい説明についてはサーベイン、彼から聞いてくれ。: For the details, ask Sabein—he'll explain.
m920086.貴様の功夫じゃと？ カッカッカ！ 笑わせてくれる。\n飛行術を操るわしに触れる事: Your kung-fu, you say? Ka-ka-ka! You're funny. You can't even touch me while I'm soaring through the skies.
m920086.邪道に堕ちる事がなければ、功名を馳せる程の\n偉人になりえたのかもしれませんが…: Had he not fallen to the heretical path, he might have become a great hero celebrated for his achievements…
m920086.闘う事を恐れ、地上に降りる事すら\nできないとは……なんと卑怯な邪仙よ！: To fear battle so much you can't even set foot on the ground… How cowardly, you treacherous immortal!
m920086.飛んでいる魔物でしたら私にお任せ下さい！\n……と言いたい所ですが、矢が通じない: If it's a flying monster, leave it to me! …I'd love to say that, but if it's that hard… hmm, what can we possibly do…
m920086.馬鹿ナ。ハクノカミ様を守る結界が、\nアのような者共に破られる筈が……。: Foolishness. The barrier protecting Lord Hakunokami shouldn't be broken by scum like them…

m920197.――あれ？ トラムちゃんにホルテウスちゃん。\nそんなところでコソコソして、どう:
――Oh? Tram-chan and Horteus-chan.
What are you two whispering about over there?
m920197.――そしてこの、ミニメカシャチのおもちゃこそ、\n我が相棒、長年の愛機だ。:
――And this Mini-Mecha Shachi toy
is my partner, a machine I've cherished for years.
m920197.――な、なんだこいつ！？\nぐわーっ！？ 俺のミニメカドラゴンがー！？:
――Wh-What the heck is this?!
Gyaaah?! My Mini Mech Dragon!
m920197.――ほう、ミニメカマンボウを撃破するか。\nなかなかどうして、やるものだな。:
――Hmph. So you defeated the Mini-Mecha Manta.
Not bad at all. You have some skill.
m920197.――キュキュ。やはり王子か。\n我々の敵となるのであれば、それは王国だと思ってい:
??? : Kyu-kyu. So it is the Prince, after all.
If you are our enemy, then you must be of the Kingdom.
m920197.――サァサァ、\nミニメカクラブウォーリアのおもちゃ、\nこのビーチ限定で無料配:
??? : ――Saa, saa,
Mini Mech Crab Warrior toys!
Free distribution, limited to this beach!
m920197.――ミニメカドラゴンバトル。\nそれは物質界全土の子どもたちが熱狂する、\n最新:
――Mini Mech Dragon Battle.
It's the latest battle hobby
that kids across the Material Realm are crazy about.
m920197.――子どもたちのおもちゃを大人買い。\nそんなの、絶対に許しません！:
—buy out the children's toys.
I will never allow that!
m920197.――少し前のこと、合同演習の休憩時間: ――A little while earlier, during a break in the joint exercise
m920197.…………あったさ。\n私にも、未来に夢を抱いた頃が……。:
…………Yes, I did.
I, too, once held dreams for the future…
m920197.……ああ、子どもらの遊びを悪用する、\n悪しき者たちの影が見えておる。:
……Yes. I can see the shadows of wicked souls
who would exploit the children's play for their own ends.
m920197.……あはは、また大所帯になりそうですね。\nシャチさんたちがびっくりしそうです。:
……Ahaha, it's going to be a big group again.
I bet the Shachi will be surprised.
m920197.……えぇと、どうやら、\nふざけているわけじゃなさそうね。:
……I see. It seems
they aren't just messing around after all.
m920197.……くっ。ここで私に振るのか。\nいいだろう、双方同意と見て良いな？\n――ミニ:
…Ugh. You're leaving this to me, are you?
Very well. I'll take it that both sides agree.
—Mini-Mecha Battle… FIGHT!!
m920197.……こうなったら、とことん懲らしめるしかないですね。:
……If it comes to that, we have no choice
but to give them a thorough lesson.
m920197.……ここからは、本気で相手をしよう。\n我が夢が、未だ潰えていないというのなら、:
……From here on, I'll take you seriously.
If my dream hasn't yet been crushed,
let me see how far I can go.
m920197.……だ、そうだ。\nさぁ行くぞトラム、まずは犯人探しに精を出すとしよう。:
……I, yes.
Come, Tram. Let us focus on finding the culprit first.
m920197.……っておい！\nあんたたちまで感化されてどうするんだ！:
……Hey!
What are you all doing, getting swept up in this too?
m920197.……ふむ。\n我らが戦友、サナラの夏の思い出に水を差すか。:
……Hmph.
So you'd ruin the summer memories of our comrade, Sanara?
m920197.……ほう、まさか古の秘術、\n海巫女どもの水中呼吸の魔法を受けたのか。:
……Hm, so you've been granted the ancient secret art
of underwater breathing by the sea priestesses?
m920197.……まさか、匹敵するか、溺れる民ごときが。:
……To think that a drowning commoner
would be my equal.
m920197.……やれやれ。\nおもちゃとは外貨を稼ぐ手段。\n感情を操作するための道具にすぎ:
……I suppose I shouldn't be surprised.
Toys are merely a means of earning foreign currency.
They are nothing more than tools for manipulating emotions.
m920197.……カガクって、科学のこと？\n驚いたな、鋼の都のような機械技術を\n深海にいな:
……Science?
Surprising. So they've acquired mechanical technology
like that of the Steel Capital,
despite being in the deep sea.
m920197.……キュキュ。\n面白い、なぜミニメカバトルと言い換えた？:
……Kyu-kyu.
Interesting. Why did you rephrase it as "Mini-Mecha Battles"?
m920197.……キュケケッ。\nスカー、貴様に褒められると、\nどうにも心が震えてしまうもの:
……Kyuukeke.
Being praised by you, Scar,
somehow makes my heart tremble.
m920197.……シャチとサメの背比べです。\nどっちもどっちです。:
……It's like comparing the size of a killer whale and a shark.
You're all in the same boat.
m920197.……ミニメカバトルは、魂の、会話。: ……A Mini-Mecha Battle is a conversation of the soul.
m920197.……古い、おもちゃですね。\nきっと長いあいだ、大切にしてきたのでしょう。:
……An old toy.
It must have been very precious to you for a long time.
m920197.……子どもの頃のように、\n大人であっても本音で語り合えるようになる、\nそれが:
……So even as adults, we can talk to each other
with our true hearts, just like when we were children.
That's what Mini-Mecha Battles are about, huh.
m920197.……本当に詳しいな。しかし、\n子供の遊びとは、得てして大人も熱中するもの、か。:
……You really do know a lot. But then again,
children's games often captivate adults too, don't they?
Very well, let me join in for a round—
m920197.……結構。\nでは、私が相手をしよう。:
……Very well.
Then I shall be your opponent.
m920197.……脳天はだめですよ？\nもうちょっと命に関わらない場所をですね？:
……Hitting them on the head is no good, okay?
Please aim for a spot that isn't life-threatening?
m920197.……見逃して、いいんでしょうか？: ……Are we really just going to let them go?
m920197.あぁっ！？ 今度は深海に逃げやがった！？:
What?!
They fled back to the deep sea this time?!
m920197.ああ、これからは正々堂々と、世界征服をしていく。: Ah, from now on, I shall conquer the world fairly and squarely.
m920197.ああ、街で流行している、\nおもちゃを使ったバトルみたいね。:
Ah, it seems to be that battle game
using toys that's all the rage in town.
m920197.ああ。最強の科学軍団、\n我がオルカ科学ラボの力を見せてやろう！:
Ah. Let us show you the power
of the strongest scientific army, my Orca Science Lab!
m920197.あっ、待って待って。\nほら、せっかくサナラが……。:
Ah, wait, wait.
Look, Sanara finally got the chance to…
m920197.あの子にとって、英傑の存在は、\n千年戦争の記憶そのものだから。\n合同訓練の合:
For her, the existence of the Heroes
is the very memory of the Millennium War.
Let her just enjoy some beach time
between joint training sessions—
m920197.あの後、オルカ科学ラボから、\n違法改造おもちゃが出荷された形跡はありません。:
After that, there's no sign that any more illegally modified toys
have been shipped out of the Orca Science Lab.
m920197.あはは……それは後日ってことで。\nふふ、王子ちゃんをどうにか誘い出して……。:
Ahaha…… let's save that for another day.
Hehe, I managed to lure the Prince out……
m920197.あらあら、そんなふらふらになって……。\nみんな、波打ち際でお水を浴びるといいで:
Oh my, you look quite dizzy…
Everyone, why don't you go cool off at the water's edge?
It's a lovely way to beat the heat.
m920197.いいじゃないですか、\n水着で活躍すれば王子ちゃんの視線を独り占めですよ！:
What's wrong with that?
If you shine in a swimsuit, you'll have the Prince's attention all to yourself!
m920197.いいや、お前らは、\n強くなろうとして、し続けて、\nしっかり強くなったんだろう:
No, that's not it. You guys
wanted to get stronger, kept pushing yourself,
and you actually became strong, didn't you?!
m920197.いえいえ、リンネさん、お茶はいかが？\nおばあちゃんが一杯淹れてあげましょう。:
Oh, please don't apologize. How about some tea, Rinne-san?
Let Granny brew you a nice cup.
m920197.うぅぅ、すまぬ……。\n日光が強すぎてな……。:
Ugh… I'm so sorry…
The sun is far too strong…
m920197.うっ、なんだか罪悪感が……。: Ugh, I'm getting a bit of a guilty feeling……
m920197.うっ、み、見てたの！？\nあの……それは、海の家を開くための練習で……。:
Ugh, did you see that?
I mean, it was just practice for setting up the beach shack…
m920197.うむ、そうだな。\n気を緩めすぎては怪我の原因にもなる。\nこのあたりで一度、引:
Mm, you're right.
Letting our guard down too much could lead to injuries.
We should tighten up our discipline around here.
m920197.うわっ、また出てきたぞ！？\n見た目が可愛いからって油断するなよ！:
Whoa, it's out again!?
Don't let your guard down just because it looks cute!
--- scene: The Crystal of Orca Science (battle, end) ---
m920197.うわーん！\n私のミニメカドラゴン壊されちゃったよぉ……。:
Waaah!
My Mini Mech Dragon got broken…
m920197.えぇ、おもちゃで誰かを傷つけるなんて、\nそんなこと、絶対許せませんから！:
Yes! Hurting someone with a toy…
I absolutely cannot forgive that!
m920197.えぇ、わかったわ。\n海の思い出を邪魔するヤツは、\nスクラップにしてやりましょ:
Yes, I understand.
Anyone who ruins the seaside memories
can just be turned into scrap!
m920197.えぇ。あの子は……ずっと、\n普通の女の子として生きたいって願っていたし、ね。:
Yes. She has always…
wished to live as an ordinary girl.
m920197.えぇっ、わ、わたしが\nシャチのギルマンの交渉担当ですか！？:
Huh? I, I'm the one
going to negotiate with the Shachi Gilman?!
m920197.えっ、ずるいずるい！\nアタシもついてくからね！:
Huh? That's not fair!
I'm coming with you!
m920197.えっ、ま、まって、水着のままなんだけど！？: Ehh, w-wait, I'm still in my swimsuit!
m920197.おぉ……テュトの茶か、ありがたい……。: Oh… Tytto's tea. How kind of you…
m920197.おばあちゃんも、みにめかばとる？\nそろそろ挑戦するべきでしょうか……。:
Grandma, do you want to try it too?
Perhaps it's time I should challenge it…
m920197.お金に目がくらんで、\n魂まで濁ってしまったんじゃないですか？:
Have you become so blinded by money
that your soul has turned murky?
m920197.くぅっ、さすがはナタクちゃん。\n私のジオマンシーアタックを弾くなんて。:
Grr, just as I thought, Nataku.
Blocking my Geomancy Attack…
m920197.くっ……あいつ海に逃げやがった！: Tch…… he escaped back into the sea!
m920197.くっ……水圧がすごいな……。\nさっき以上に身体が重いぞ……。:
Tsk… the water pressure is intense…
My body feels heavier than before…
m920197.こちらはいつも、送り出す側ゆえな……。\nしかし、皆元気に戻ってくれば、それがな:
We are always the ones sending them off…
But as long as everyone comes back safe, that is all that matters.
m920197.この物語は、ある夏の日、\n浜辺で遊ぶ子ども――いえ、大人たち？ の、\n激しい:
This story begins on a summer day,
with a fierce battle between children playing on the beach—
or rather, adults? …Something like that.
m920197.これが訓練でなく、\n休暇であればなお良かったのだがな。:
It would have been even better
if this were a vacation rather than training.
m920197.さぁ、到着したぞ。\nレギュレーションは深海、\nオーナーもバトル参加ＯＫの全力:
Well, we've arrived.
The regulations are deep-sea,
and owners are allowed to participate in full-power battles.
m920197.さっきのは、\nもしかして、ミニメカクラブウォーリアのおもちゃ？:
Was that…
a Mini Mech Crab Warrior toy?
m920197.さて、どうだろうな。\n心が躍っていることは否定しないが、\nここで、貴様らを溺:
Well, let's see.
I won't deny that I'm excited,
but I might be planning to drown you here.
m920197.しかし、それに溺れる民の――\n乾いた地の子どもたちを巻き込むのは、\n確かに卑:
However, dragging the people who were obsessed with it—
the children of the arid lands—into this
was indeed a cowardly act.
m920197.しかし、ギルマン同士の勢力争い、\n深海の権力闘争、魔物の襲来が続き、\nそんな:
But the power struggles among Gilman, the political machinations of the deep, and the relentless invasions of monsters…
I learned that such dreams were impossible to fulfill.
m920197.しかしヒレナシの溺れる地の民では、\n我らシャチの一族に追いつくことなど不可能。:
But you finless, drowning land-dwellers
have no chance of catching up to our Orca clan.
m920197.せかいせーふく？ まだ諦めてないの！？: “World Safety”? You're not giving up yet?!
m920197.そういうものか……。\nやっぱ戦う連中の考えってのはわかりにくいな。:
Is that so…
It's hard to understand how these fighters think.
m920197.そういうシルヴィアさんも、\n王子に日焼け止めを塗ってもらっていたような……。: And yet, I seem to recall you having the Prince apply sunscreen for you, Silvia…
m920197.そうそう。\nわからず屋はぶっ飛ばす！\n脳天どつけばだいたい通じあえるよ！:
Exactly.
We just have to knock the senseless ones out!
If you bonk them on the head, they usually start to get it!
m920197.そう！？ そうなの！？\nよ、よぉし、頑張っちゃおうかしら……。:
Really? Is that so?
A-alright, let's give it our all…
m920197.そこまで！\n……気のせいか、\n普段の装備の時よりやる気を出していたな。:
That's enough!
…Am I imagining things, or were they more motivated
than when they were in their regular gear?
m920197.それでは、此度の事件解決、お疲れ様でした！: Well then, good work on resolving this incident!
m920197.それは……だって、この世界に生まれたおもちゃは、\nそれ自体に善悪なんて、関係な:
It's just that… toys born into this world
don't inherently have good or evil in them…
m920197.そんな悪事をたくらむ人が、この状況で、\nおもちゃのスイッチをオンにしたりすると:
Do you really think someone plotting such evil deeds
would turn on the toy's switch in this situation?
m920197.そーだそーだ！\nレギュレーション違反は出場禁止なんですよー！:
That's right, that's right!
Rule violations mean disqualification!
m920197.ただ、そろそろ止めに行った方がいいのも事実です。\nこのまま休憩時間を続けていた:
That said, it is time to put a stop to this.
If we keep taking breaks like this,
we won't finish the exercise schedule.
m920197.だぁーれが溺れる民だってぇ？\nアタシたちにはヒレがなくても、船があるんだなー！:
Who's a drowning land-dweller?!
We may not have fins, but we've got ships!
m920197.だから、世界征服を企んだってことか……。\n世界最強はシャチなんだって、示すため:
So that's why you're planning world conquest…
